## Gate

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck` — 0 errors
- [ ] `pnpm test` — green against real D1/R2
- [ ] `pnpm build` — green
- [ ] `pnpm test:e2e` — green (extended if a happy path changed)
- [ ] Browser smoke-check of pages/routes outside the E2E flows
- [ ] Schema change ships its migration (renamed, journal tag updated)
- [ ] `docs/solutions/` entry added if something non-obvious was learned
